what: On hover, the speech-bubble name tag bounces twice around its bottom-left corner — at 25% it rises 40% of its own height tilted -5°, sits down at 50%, at 75% rises 20% tilted 5° and sits down (.5s linear, once per hover). It is the hand-wave gesture where the bubble and name tag next to the logo bob as if saying hello

options.[data-fx-part=bubble]: Speech bubble to bounce (child). If none, the attached element itself
options.--fx-lift: First bounce height (ratio of own height), default 40% — second bounce is half of that

from.where: shared.js header logo .ts-logo__text (original .linkLogo:hover .logoText — animationBound .5s linear, transform-origin left bottom)
